justification: Evaluates stability metrics of original paper's signature on original normalized-count scale.
notes: Baseline primary stability check. No public labels used to partition.

justification: Assesses how log2 transformation affects cluster stability, motivated by Phase 3B replication changes.
notes: Phase 3B showed 26 sample assignment changes when applying median subtraction to log2 scale.

justification: Evaluates if natural cohort structure supports K=3 without using predefined subtype signatures.
notes: Gene selection rule: Top 1000 genes by MAD on log2 counts. Fixed before seeing cluster agreement.

justification: Assesses whether stability metrics improve or change when excluding 4 flagged Phase 2A outliers.
notes: Samples YX16135T, YX16158T, YX16194T, and YX16224T are excluded.

justification: Evaluates unsupervised cohort structure stability without the 4 outliers.
notes: Samples YX16135T, YX16158T, YX16194T, and YX16224T are excluded.

justification: Tests whether primary clustering is robust to random subsets of the signature genes.
notes: Simultaneously resamples 80% of samples and 80% of the 94 signature genes.

justification: Verifies that using the alternative gene-median imputed expression matrix has no effect on stability.
notes: Uses the alternative Phase 2B imputed matrix for signature genes.

justification: Tests whether the unsupervised representation stability changes under a more stringent filtering and smaller HVG set.
notes: HVGs restricted to top 500 by MAD. Threshold count increased to 10 in >=20% samples.
